# defectdojo_jira_project (List Resource)

Lists the DefectDojo Jira projects, the Jira configurations of products and engagements, ordered by ID, with the display name `<project key> / <product or engagement>`.

Requires Terraform 1.14 or later. Terraform returns at most 100 results unless the `list` block sets `limit`. `terraform query -generate-config-out` writes every attribute that has a value, including those the provider otherwise leaves to others when they are not configured (such as `authorized_users` and `tags`): remove the ones another system manages before applying the generated configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the Jira projects of products and engagements, and generate import
# blocks and configuration with:
#   terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf
list "defectdojo_jira_project" "all" {
  provider = defectdojo
}

# Only the Jira project of one product
list "defectdojo_jira_project" "shop" {
  provider = defectdojo

  config {
    product_id = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `engagement_id` (Number) Only list the Jira project of the engagement with this ID.
- `product_id` (Number) Only list the Jira project of the product with this ID.
